family_reports.body: I step in to a girl's life who had no parents and spouse just died of a massive stroke after her youngest child came home from an extended stay in the NICU. As a result of my advocacy and my taking her in to my family I have been severely punished through the courts for advocating for her and for my grandchildren. I adopted her in a legal adult adoption and I have tried to advocate for her and my grandchildren's due process rights from the beginning and as a result these judges have conspired together with caseworkers each other law enforcement and other agencies to deny us due process and to have me jailed repeatedly including having me illegally evicted from my home of eight years that I was in a contract for deed on they had me illegally evicted through a rent and possession case. Then the same judges had four protection orders placed against me without single threat of violence to anyone to keep me out of my grandchildren's lives and keep me from having any opportunity to intervene in their case. They have done everything in their power to have me taking completely out of the picture including having me jailed for nothing more than protesting, removed from courthouse property for doing nothing more than protesting excluding any of my emotions and directing their Court clerks not to even file my emotions without their prior approval which is unlawful. They have had me removed not only from hearings well they've never had me removed from a hearing they have disallowed me from coming to hearing and had me removed completely from courthouse property with no reason other than they wanted to keep me from the hearing. I was not allowed in the hearing and I was not allowed to enter the courthouse. Where I have stepped up to take a person into my family and care for them and help to guide them when they had no one else because both of her parents are dead from suicides in her past and the baby's father just died with a massive stroke I have been punished to no end for advocating for her. And I still continue to fight! They took them from our church. The church we had attended for 2 years and had no idea that Missouri Baptist Children's home had an office in the basement of our church. Even if we would have known we would have not had any concerns because the children were never abused or neglected. Either way I went to my church for advocacy and for them to help us when I got a call from the caseworker to turn my grandchildren over immediately or he was going to have an Amber alert issued I got my grandchildren and my sister in the car and went to our church for advocacy and instead my grandchildren were taking into custody by Missouri Baptist Children's home in the basement without any lawful reason they had no court order they had no warrant and there was no imminent danger. Also there is no report filed and no body cam footage from the incident at the church where my grandchildren were taken into custody. Two different law enforcement agencies were involved in the removal of my grandchildren from the church and no one has any reports or any documents or video footage of the incident. No one will take accountability and no one will tell the truth. The entire thing has been unlawful right from the start. I have a police report from the day before my grandchildren were ever taken into custody with listing them as already living at the foster home address. And address that they should not even be associated with for a week or more. It's a clear indication there was a prior determination of placement before the children were ever removed. I did this at my church they tried to turn me against God and my whole family against God. A church where we had attended for 2 years is where they did this! How sad is that? They tried to use my past as the reason they removed the children but I was not the one in physical custody of my grandchildren my sister was and she has no history of drug use no history of any arrests or any law enforcement interaction whatsoever and they leave her name completely out of the paperwork. Indicating that I am inappropriate placement because I have a prior history of drug use from more than 10 years prior. They state that I live in the removal home which is also untrue. I just was in the process of buying the home that they were living in I was not living in it I live next door in an apartment of my own. My sister lived in the same home with the children and their mother and all of their children they left two children in the home and took two children. The two children with the social security checks are the ones they said were in imminent danger and they needed to remove them! I wonder why that is what it have anything to do with our social security checks? I believe it does!

This system has created a year in school, where my daughter has performed the least successfully she has regressing from threes and above into ones. My son has missed the most days out of the school year. He possibly can. My daughter had to be put in achievement court because of how bad her grades are she has lost out on other school activities and getting to participate in corral which she auditioned for and got because my coparent does not do homework with her. She has fallen behind a minimum of 100 homework assignments just the semester and I have done my work during my limited time with them catching her up on every homework assignment. My son has missed more days out of the school year this year than he ever did before. Both children are experiencing emotional disturbances, nightmare, nightmares, bad wedding, and emotional meltdowns, which are on video and have been recorded.
